description: Search Westminster bill summaries by title, current or originating House, session, sponsoring member, department, reference stage, bill type or status, with optional official ordering. Use ukparl_lookup_reference for stage/type/department IDs and ukparl_get_bill for complete selected records. Department IDs are distinct from answering-body IDs. inAmendableStage=true restricts to amendable stages; false is unrestricted. No session or date scope is inferred. Follow collection cursors with the same filters; use contentCursor to reconstruct an oversized item.

Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.
